mapper.select: SELECT commoncode_number AS code , codename_1 AS name , unit_price AS unitPrice FROM commoncode WHERE joint_code_group_name = '서류발급종류' AND used = 'Y' ORDER BY commoncode_number

SELECT d.receive_number , d.medical_number , m.member_name , d.document_contents , d.document_type , d.receive_use , TO_CHAR(d.receive_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS receiveDate , d.receive_state , cc.unit_price , rr.REGISTER_A AS diagnosis , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS doctorName , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS birthDate , m.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone , m.PRIMARY_ADDRESS || ' ' || NVL(m.DETAILED_ADDRESS, '') AS address , TO_CHAR(rr.TREATMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS treatmentDate , rr.REGISTER_P AS treatmentPlan FROM receptionist_documents d INNER JOIN receptionist_register rr ON rr.medical_number = d.medical_number INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_number = rr.member_number LEFT JOIN member doc ON doc.member_number = rr.doctor_number LEFT JOIN commoncode cc ON cc.joint_code_group_name = '서류발급종류' AND cc.codename_1 = d.document_contents
m.member_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY d.receive_number DESC

SELECT d.receive_number , d.medical_number , d.document_type , d.document_contents , d.receive_state , cc.unit_price FROM receptionist_documents d LEFT JOIN commoncode cc ON cc.joint_code_group_name = '서류발급종류' AND cc.codename_1 = d.document_type WHERE d.receive_number = #{receiveNumber}
